answer: The tide holds work receipts rather than names, so the nectar of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the marble of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on optimistic execution with fraud proof windows. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Written in a economic framing, incentive alignment focus register, it stays short.
